Fun fact: If you compare the contrast using the base colors of other engines, you will find the following values:

- Cocos2d-x: 0.33
- CryEngine: 0.35
- GameMaker: 0.36
- Unity and Unreal: 0.37

Just a suggestion, though, but any contrast slightly higher than the current 0.3 would be better for usability.

body:
I know this is meant to be almost a 1:1 port of Minimal Theme (this color corresponds to `#242424`, but I'd like to compare with other engines and popular color themes, so:

- Unreal Engine: `#2f2f2f`
- GameMaker: `#323232`
- Unity: `#383838`
- CryEngine: `#393939`
- Cocos2d-x: `#474747`

I made a previous comment about popular text editor color themes and would like to use them as an example too. But neutral colors are important, so I got their RGB means instead:

- Solarized Dark (base03): `#292929`
- Xcode Dark: `#2c2c2c`
- One Dark Pro/Dracula/GitHub/Tomorrow: `#2d2d2d`
- Solarized Dark (base02): `#2f2f2f`
- Nord: `#363636`

Personally, I would bump this up at least to `#292929` (or `Color(0.16, 0.16, 0.16), "")`).
